_artifact: Consumed-decisions registry - external anti-replay state for VERIFY-P0-01 (--consumed).
_scope: Covers the PROPOSED decision PG-P0-CLOSURE-002 as well as the already-signed PG-P0-CLOSURE-001. Neither is consumed.
_status: EMPTY BY DESIGN. No decision has been consumed. Neither PG-P0-CLOSURE-001 nor PG-P0-CLOSURE-002 is recorded here.
_why_empty: Consumption means a decision has been SPENT on an executed transition. The only verification of PG-P0-CLOSURE-001 to date (EVD-CLOSURE-014, C5) was an ADVISORY pre-execution check by an independent checker: it mutated no register, created no commit, and moved no ref. Recording it as consumed would retroactively reclassify an advisory verification as an execution, would make the genuine C8 apply look like a replay of an already-spent decision, and would let a maker manufacture consumption state the human never authorized. A prior candidate (rejected as 2134ea2d53f78b79522b476e78f4b33022595615, REJECT_EXACT_SHA) made exactly that error. PG-P0-CLOSURE-002 is unsigned and cannot have been consumed by anything.
_who_may_write_this: The human operator, at or after a real C8 execution commit, recording the transition actually applied. A maker agent must not pre-populate it.
_schema_note: Flat map: decision_id -> {predecessor_digest, successor_digest}, matching tools/verify_phase_transition.py's internal `consumed` shape, so this file can be passed directly via --consumed. An empty object is a valid, fully-fail-closed input: with no entry present, the first genuine verification yields VERIFIED_EXACT rather than a spurious ALREADY_VERIFIED_EXACT.
_authority: Maker-prepared scaffold. NOT an authority record. Its digest is bound into the unsigned mandate proposal so the human signs over the exact anti-replay state in force at signing time.
